short_description: Start your engines for a rally adventure across Europe and Africa! Manage your team, vehicle, and supplies as you navigate treacherous terrains. Each challenge on the road forces tough decisions that impact your journey. Ride to glory in this retro-inspired strategy with a roguelike twist!
